test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the area of an equilateral triangle of side x to the area of a square of side x is:
solution: Given: Side of the equilateral triangle = x Side of the square = x Formula Used: Area of an equilateral triangle = frac{sqrt{3}}{4} x² Area of a square = x2 Calculation: Area of the equilateral triangle = frac{sqrt{3}}{4} x² Area of the square = x2 Ratio of the areas = frac{frac{sqrt{3}}{4} x²}{x²} ⇒ Ratio of the areas = frac{sqrt{3}}{4} ⇒ Ratio of the areas = sqrt{3} : 4
